hint.combat_styles.damage: Flat damage this deals on its own. Needs no target or triggering hit. Ignored when a Damage Spec is set.
hint.combat_styles.ignite: Sets the target on fire for a number of seconds.
hint.combat_styles.lifesteal: Heals you for a share of the damage dealt.
hint.combat_styles.knockback: Pushes the target away, or pulls it in.
hint.combat_styles.splash: Damages everything within a radius of the target.
hint.combat_styles.status_effects: Potion effects applied to the target.
hint.combat_styles.projectiles: Fires entities such as arrows on hit.
hint.combat_styles.echo: Repeats this effect a number of times after a delay.
hint.combat_styles.freeze_ticks: Ticks of freezing applied to the target.
hint.combat_styles.offense: Damage-shaping mechanics such as execute and chain.
hint.combat_styles.motion: Movement such as dash or blink when this fires.
hint.combat_styles.condition: Requirements that must all pass for this to fire.
hint.combat_styles.attack_condition.not_: Only swings when you are not dual wielding.
hint.combat_styles.attack_condition.dual: Only swings while dual wielding any two one-handed weapons.
Only swings while dual wielding two of the same item.
Only swings while dual wielding two weapons of the same weapon type.
hint.combat_styles.attack_condition.no_o: Only swings with an empty off hand.
hint.combat_styles.attack_condition.off_: Meant to need a shield in the off hand, but BetterCombat 2.4.0 never checks it, so it always passes.
hint.combat_styles.attack_condition.main: Only swings from the main hand; skipped on off-hand swings while dual wielding.
hint.combat_styles.attack_condition.off_: Only swings from the off hand while dual wielding.
hint.combat_styles.cooldown: Ticks before this can fire again, plus an optional armed window.
hint.combat_styles.max_targets_per_swing: Caps how many targets one swing affects.
hint.combat_styles.execute: Bonus damage below a health threshold.
hint.combat_styles.chain: Jumps to nearby targets, losing damage each jump.
hint.combat_styles.cleave: Hits everything in an arc around the target.
hint.combat_styles.dash: Lunges you forward, optionally toward the target.
hint.combat_styles.shield: Grants absorption hearts for a duration.
hint.combat_styles.disarm: Briefly stops the target from attacking.
hint.combat_styles.vault: Launches nearby entities away from the impact.
hint.combat_styles.effects: Potion effects applied to the target.
hint.combat_styles.times: How many times the echo repeats.
hint.combat_styles.ratio: Share of the original effect each repeat deals.
hint.combat_styles.trail: Trail colour this affix paints on the swing.
hint.combat_styles.applies_to: Limits which attacks this affix can roll onto.
hint.combat_styles.entities: Limits to these entities. Empty means any.
hint.combat_styles.tuning: Adjusts the values of what this applies to.
hint.combat_styles.conditions: All of these must pass. On a summon variant the variant applies; on an attack, BetterCombat only swings it while they pass and skips it in the combo otherwise.
hint.combat_styles.ability_pick: How the summon chooses which ability to cast. in_order: the one at its spawn position. random: any ready ability from the list. cycle: steps through the list, skipping abilities on cooldown.
hint.combat_styles.recast_ticks: While idle, the summon casts again on this interval, picking with Ability pick. 0 or empty never recasts, so it only acts when ordered.
hint.combat_styles.aim: What the ability is aimed at. hit_target: the enemy hit (or your last hit). look: what you're looking at. nearest / lowest_health: the closest or weakest enemy in aim range. attacker: whoever last hurt you. owner: you.
hint.combat_styles.cooldown_ticks: Ticks before this can fire again. On an ability: a summon skips it while recasting or reacting (orders ignore it). On a passive: that passive waits this long after firing.
hint.combat_styles.used_by: Summon entities that can cast this ability. Empty means any summon.
hint.combat_styles.description: Optional. Shown under the ability's name in item tooltips (hold Ctrl). Plain text or a lang key. Left empty, the ability's ability.<namespace>.<id>.desc lang entry is used if one exists.
hint.combat_styles.focus: Where the summon points during the cast and where beams and at-focus actions land. target: its target. look: your crosshair. self: the summon. owner: you. ahead: straight in front of the summon.
hint.combat_styles.steps: What the ability does over its duration. Each step runs one action at its tick.
hint.combat_styles.at: When the step fires: start (tick 0), windup (tick = tuning windup_ticks) or end (last tick of duration_ticks). Can also be a tick number.
hint.combat_styles.until: Last tick a repeating step may fire (inclusive): start, windup, end or a tick number. With no Every set, the step fires every tick until then. Empty: keeps repeating until the ability ends.
hint.combat_styles.every: Repeat the step on this interval from its start until Until, or until the ability ends. 0 fires once, or every tick when Until is set.
hint.combat_styles.action: The engine action this step runs.
hint.combat_styles.action.type: beam, burst, projectile, dash_strike, pull, apply_stacks, consume_stacks, heal_owner, rise, sound, particles or cast_spell.
hint.combat_styles.damage_ratio: Multiplier on this step's damage: its own Damage Spec if set, otherwise the ability's. 1 is full damage; 0 deals none.
hint.combat_styles.at_focus: Centre the area on the focus point instead of on the summon.
hint.combat_styles.action.effect: Status effect used as stacks. Empty uses the ability's applies effect.
hint.combat_styles.per_stack: Consume stacks: bonus damage per stack removed, as a share of this action's damage.
hint.combat_styles.heal_ratio: Heals you by this share of the step's damage: the step Damage Spec if it has one, otherwise the ability's. With no damage set anywhere this heals 0.
hint.combat_styles.action.sound: Sound played at the summon, using the ability's volume and pitch.
hint.combat_styles.particle: Particle sent at the summon, or at the focus when At focus is on. Count and spread come from the ability's fx.
hint.combat_styles.action.spell: Spell Engine spell to cast. Mob summons cast it themselves; other summons cast it with your spell power, and projectile spells launch from the summon.
hint.combat_styles.spell_tuning: Changes applied to the cast spell, like extra launches or power.
hint.combat_styles.style_page: Can be found naturally or not.
hint.combat_styles.finale: Ability used as the summon.s finishing move.
hint.combat_styles.equipped: Requires this item equipped in an accessory slot.
hint.combat_styles.inverted: Flips the condition, so it passes when not met.
hint.combat_styles.order: Commands your summons: make them use an ability, or quicken their next recast.
hint.combat_styles.targets: Which of your summons take the order: all, one, a random one, anchored, temporary or the nearest.
hint.combat_styles.hasten: Speeds up your next attack in the sequence.
hint.combat_styles.attributes: Attribute modifiers applied for a duration.
hint.combat_styles.summons: Entities summoned to fight for you.
hint.combat_styles.commands: Server commands run when this fires.
hint.combat_styles.multiplier: Scales the effect when the condition passes.
hint.combat_styles.refund_slot: Gives the combo slot back instead of consuming it.
hint.combat_styles.self_health_below: Only fires while your health is below this share.
hint.combat_styles.self_health_above: Only fires while your health is above this share.
hint.combat_styles.target_health_below: Only fires while the target is below this share.
hint.combat_styles.target_health_above: Only fires while the target is above this share.
hint.combat_styles.crouching: Only fires while you are crouching.
hint.combat_styles.has_spell: Requires the held item to carry a Spell Engine spell. Needs Spell Engine installed.
hint.combat_styles.has_spell_school: Requires the main-hand item to carry a spell of one of these schools (for example fire). Needs Spell Engine installed.
hint.combat_styles.casting_spell: Requires the player to be casting a spell right now. Needs Spell Engine installed.
hint.combat_styles.cast_spell: Spell Engine casting. Casting is live while you cast, Cast fires once per cast, Channel fires each channel tick.
hint.combat_styles.cast_spell.phase: Casting: live while a cast is in progress. Cast: fires once when a spell goes off. Channel: fires on every channel tick.
hint.combat_styles.cast_type: Only spells of these cast types: standard, channel or charge. Empty means any.
hint.combat_styles.include_triggered: Also count spells fired by other spells' triggers, not just ones you cast.
hint.combat_styles.cast_spell.spell: Only these spells. Empty means any spell.
hint.combat_styles.cast_spell.school: Only spells of these schools. Empty means any school.
hint.combat_styles.spell_projectile: Only fires for Spell Engine spell projectiles, optionally filtered by spell or school.
hint.combat_styles.name: Name shown in the tooltip.
hint.combat_styles.ignore_iframes: Each hit lands even if the target was just hurt.
hint.combat_styles.cast_spells: Casts a Spell Engine spell for free, with its full delivery.
hint.combat_styles.cast_target: Who the spell is cast at. Auto picks the hit target, or where you look.
hint.combat_styles.channel_duration: Ticks a channelled spell keeps pulsing. 0 uses the spell's own.
hint.combat_styles.grant: Spells added to your spell bar while this is active.
hint.combat_styles.disable: Spells locked while this is active.
hint.combat_styles.disable_schools: Every spell of these schools is locked while this is active.
hint.combat_styles.disable_mode: Block keeps the slot but refuses the cast. Remove takes it off the bar.
hint.combat_styles.tune: Tunes these spells whenever you cast them while this is active.
hint.combat_styles.cooldown_reduction: Seconds taken off the spell's cooldown.
hint.combat_styles.spell: Spells that count. Leave empty for any spell.
hint.combat_styles.cast_spells.tuning: Scales what the spell already does, on top of its own impacts.
hint.combat_styles.spell_projectile.tuni: Scales what the spell already does, on top of its own impacts.
hint.combat_styles.power_multiplier: Multiplies the spell power its impacts scale from.
hint.combat_styles.critical_chance_bonus: Added to the critical chance of the spell impacts.
hint.combat_styles.critical_damage_bonus: Added to the critical damage of the spell impacts.
hint.combat_styles.ricochet: Extra ricochets on top of the spell own perks.
hint.combat_styles.pierce: Extra pierces on top of the spell own perks.
hint.combat_styles.bounce: Extra bounces on top of the spell own perks.
hint.combat_styles.channel_ticks_add: Added to the spell channel length.
hint.combat_styles.effect_duration_add: Added to the duration of status effects the spell applies.
hint.combat_styles.effect_amplifier_add: Added to the amplifier of status effects the spell applies.
hint.combat_styles.impact_type: Power and crit bonuses only apply to impacts of these types, such as damage or heal. Empty means any type.
hint.combat_styles.impact_school: Power and crit bonuses only apply to impacts of these schools. It filters, it does not change the school. Empty means any school.
hint.combat_styles.ricochet_range: Added to how far a ricochet can jump.
hint.combat_styles.knockback_multiply: Added to the spell knockback multiplier.
hint.combat_styles.launch: How many projectiles one shot launches and how they fly.
hint.combat_styles.extra_launches: Projectiles launched after the first one.
hint.combat_styles.launch_delay: Ticks between extra launches. 0 keeps the spell's own delay.
hint.combat_styles.meteor_radius_add: Added to how far falling projectiles scatter.
hint.combat_styles.chain_reaction: Spawns more projectiles when this one hits.
hint.combat_styles.triggers: How many times the chain reaction can fire.
hint.combat_styles.increment: Added to the size each time the chain fires.
hint.combat_styles.spell_projectile.scho: Spell schools that count, such as fire or arcane.
hint.combat_styles.on_miss: Fires when the swing hits nothing.
hint.combat_styles.on_kill: Fires when the swing kills the target.
hint.combat_styles.on_summon_hit: Fires when one of your summons lands a hit.
hint.combat_styles.requires_affix: Only fires while the named affix is present.
hint.combat_styles.last_slot: On: only the final attack of the sequence. Off: every attack except the final one.
hint.combat_styles.slot_index: Only fires on this sequence slot, counting from 0. Negative counts from the end: -1 is the final attack, -2 the one before it.
hint.combat_styles.idle_ticks: Only fires after standing idle this many ticks.
hint.combat_styles.hitbox: Only fires for attacks using this hitbox shape.
hint.combat_styles.style_id: Only fires for this attack style.
hint.combat_styles.affix_id: The affix this rule refers to.
hint.combat_styles.slots: Which sequence slots this applies to: a list like [0, 2], or a range {from, to, except}. Negative counts from the end (-1 = final). from defaults to 0, to to -1, so {"except": [-1]} is every attack but the last.
hint.combat_styles.slot_band: Applies to the opening, middle, or closing attacks.
hint.combat_styles.styles: Attack styles used for the replacement.
hint.combat_styles.mode: How this is applied. Substitution: how the replacement is applied to the sequence. Stacking: repeat fires the effect once per stack; multiply fires it once with its hit-based amounts (splash, bonus damage, lifesteal) multiplied by the stack count.
hint.combat_styles.weapon_categories: Limits this to the listed weapon categories.
hint.combat_styles.item_tags: Limits this to items in the listed tags.
hint.combat_styles.borrow_slots: Takes slots from the weapon's own sequence.
hint.combat_styles.linger_ticks: How long the replacement stays active.
hint.combat_styles.abilities: Abilities granted to the summon, cycled per slot.
hint.combat_styles.max_active: How many of these may exist at once.
hint.combat_styles.lifespan: Ticks the summon lives for. 20 ticks = 1 second.
hint.combat_styles.damage_scaling: Scales summon damage by a source.
hint.combat_styles.exempt: Entity ids left alone. Everything else is replaced.
hint.combat_styles.anchored: Keeps the summon near you instead of roaming.
hint.combat_styles.replaces_summons: Turns replacement on. Without it nothing is swapped.
hint.combat_styles.damage_share: Share of your damage each ordered summon deals.
hint.combat_styles.max_diving: How many summons at once. 0 means all.
hint.combat_styles.hitbox_offset: Shifts the attack's hitbox in world space.
hint.combat_styles.extras: Additional attacks fired alongside the swing.
hint.combat_styles.trigger.chance: When the conditions are met, roll this chance. On hit, on swing and other firing parts roll each time they would fire. Attributes, spells, augments, substitutions and other always-on parts roll once per combo cycle. In a group this is the member's weight and stays in sync with the group.
hint.combat_styles.weight: Relative likelihood when rolling this affix.
hint.combat_styles.rarity: Rarity tier shown on the item.
hint.combat_styles.on_hit: Effects that fire when the attack lands.
hint.combat_styles.on_swing: Effects that fire when the attack swings.
See every line this effect adds to the item tooltip. Hide, rewrite or add lines, or hide the whole effect.
screen.combat_styles.tooltip_editor_hide: Removes this effect from the item tooltip completely.

screen.combat_styles.tooltip_editor_line: Left click: rewrite this line (blank or {line} restores it). Right click: hide or show it. Placeholders stay live. Other lines can use this one as {#n} or {#n.v}.

The effect changed and this line is no longer generated, so the edit does nothing. Clear it.

Click All / Ctrl / No Ctrl: show this line always, only while Ctrl is held (adds a [Ctrl] mark), or only without Ctrl. Hold Ctrl to see the Ctrl view in the Result.
screen.combat_styles.tooltip_editor_inde: ‹ › shift this line in or out by one level (up to 4).
screen.combat_styles.tooltip_editor_icon: Click the gem cell to pick this line's bullet icon, "none" for no icon, or default to keep the generated one.
screen.combat_styles.tooltip_editor_move: ▲ ▼ move this line, or drag it in the Result.
screen.combat_styles.tooltip_editor_refs: Use {#n} for line n, or {#n.v} for value v of line n.

hint.combat_styles.tooltip_header: Replaces the "When …" line. A lang key or plain text.
hint.combat_styles.tooltip_lines: Replaces everything generated under the header. One entry per line; lang keys or plain text.
screen.combat_styles.error_missing: '%s' is required here but not set.
screen.combat_styles.error_missing_why: This block has no default for it.
screen.combat_styles.error_dropped: Not a field of this block: %s
screen.combat_styles.error_dropped_why: Only fields this block defines are saved, so these would be discarded.
screen.combat_styles.error_range: %s is outside the allowed range %s to %s.
screen.combat_styles.effect_row_delay.hi: Wait this many ticks after the trigger fires before the whole effect runs. Zero runs it immediately.
screen.combat_styles.effect_row_stacking: Counts a source (an enchantment level, attribute or spell power) in steps of Per. Repeat fires the effect once per stack; Multiply scales its damage by the stack count.
hint.combat_styles.per: How much of the source makes one stack. Per 2 with Sharpness V gives 2 stacks.
hint.combat_styles.min_stacks: Stacks never go below this. 0 means the effect doesn't fire at all when the source is too low.
screen.combat_styles.effect_row_self_eff: Status effects applied to you when this effect fires, whatever the trigger.
hint.combat_styles.base: Flat damage added before any scaling.
hint.combat_styles.of_target_max_health: Fraction of the target's maximum health.
hint.combat_styles.of_target_missing_hea: Fraction of the health the target has already lost.
hint.combat_styles.of_self_missing_healt: Fraction of the health you have already lost.
hint.combat_styles.minimum: Floor: the result is never lower than this.
hint.combat_styles.maximum: Ceiling: the result is never higher than this.
hint.combat_styles.proportional: Splits the damage across several types by share.
hint.combat_styles.share: Portion of the total for this type.
hint.combat_styles.damage_bonus: Each entry raises damage of the listed damage types.
hint.combat_styles.damage_bonus.damage_t: Damage types or #tags this boosts. Leave empty to boost all damage.
hint.combat_styles.damage_bonus.amount: add_value: flat damage added. multiply_base: 0.2 = +20%, summed with others. multiply_total: 0.2 = x1.2, multiplied.
hint.combat_styles.damage_bonus.operatio: add_value adds flat damage, multiply_base adds a summed percent, multiply_total multiplies the result.
hint.combat_styles.damage_bonus.stacks: On: adds up with other bonuses. Off: only the strongest bonus with the same types and operation counts.
hint.combat_styles.type: Damage type id used for this portion.
hint.combat_styles.flat: Flat damage added on top of the ratio.
hint.combat_styles.scaling_mode: sum adds all; strongest uses the largest.
hint.combat_styles.source: Attribute, Spell Power, enchantment or Use to read. Enchantments read the main hand by default: enchantment:<id>; use enchantment@offhand:<id> or enchantment@highest:<id> for another slot. use:charge (0 to 1), use:held_seconds and use:held_ticks read the Use that fired the effect.
hint.combat_styles.per_point: How much each point of the source contributes.
hint.combat_styles.cap: Upper limit on the bonus this entry can add.
hint.combat_styles.health: Health conditions that gate this trigger.
hint.combat_styles.self_above: Only while your health is above this fraction.
hint.combat_styles.self_below: Only while your health is below this fraction.
hint.combat_styles.target_above: Target's health is above this fraction.
hint.combat_styles.target_below: Target's health is below this fraction.
hint.combat_styles.speed: Launch speed in blocks per tick.
hint.combat_styles.spread: Random scatter applied to the direction.
hint.combat_styles.anchor: Point the spawn offset is measured from.
hint.combat_styles.forward: Offset along the direction you are facing.
hint.combat_styles.right: Offset to your right from the anchor.
hint.combat_styles.inherit_motion: Fraction of your own motion added to the spawn.
hint.combat_styles.aim_at_target: Aims at the entity you hit.
hint.combat_styles.gravity: Downward acceleration per tick. 0 flies straight.
hint.combat_styles.drag: Speed lost per tick to air resistance.
hint.combat_styles.acceleration: Speed gained per tick while in flight.
hint.combat_styles.homing: How strongly it curves toward a target, from 0 to 1.
hint.combat_styles.from_target: Spawns at the target instead of at you.
hint.combat_styles.remove_on_landing: Despawns as soon as it hits ground or a wall.
hint.combat_styles.stop_at_entities: Stops on the first entity hit.
hint.combat_styles.cancel_if_short: Cancels the effect when you cannot pay the cost.
hint.combat_styles.hunger: Hunger points spent each time this fires.
hint.combat_styles.experience_levels: Experience levels spent each time this fires.
hint.combat_styles.ticks: Cooldown length in ticks. 20 ticks is one second.
hint.combat_styles.shared: Shares one cooldown across every effect on the item.
hint.combat_styles.max_targets: Most entities this can affect at once.
hint.combat_styles.health_threshold: Health fraction at or below which this applies.
hint.combat_styles.bonus_ratio: Damage multiplier when the threshold is met.
hint.combat_styles.instant_kill: Kills outright instead of dealing bonus damage.
hint.combat_styles.repeat_on_kill: Fires again when the hit kills.
hint.combat_styles.hits_attacker: Also strikes whoever you are fighting.
hint.combat_styles.inherit: Copies type and school from the hit.
hint.combat_styles.max_amplifier: Highest level the stacking can reach.
hint.combat_styles.amplifier: Effect level, starting at 0 for level I.
hint.combat_styles.duration: How long it lasts, in ticks.
hint.combat_styles.cooldown_scale: Multiplies the cooldown of the ability it uses.
hint.combat_styles.cost_override: Replaces the ability cost with this value.
hint.combat_styles.ignore_affinity: Ignores school affinity when picking a target.
hint.combat_styles.resolve: How conflicts between several matches are settled.
hint.combat_styles.shape: Hitbox shape used for this attack.
hint.combat_styles.shapes: Extra hitbox shapes attached to this attack.
hint.combat_styles.boxes: Individual hitboxes making up the shape.
hint.combat_styles.width: Size along the X axis, in blocks.
hint.combat_styles.height: Size along the Y axis, in blocks.
hint.combat_styles.depth: Size along the Z axis, in blocks.
hint.combat_styles.offset: Position offset from the attack origin.
hint.combat_styles.roll: Rotation around the forward axis, in degrees.
hint.combat_styles.local_yaw: Rotation around the vertical axis, in degrees.
hint.combat_styles.angle: Arc width of the attack, in degrees.
hint.combat_styles.placement: Where the shape sits relative to the attack.
hint.combat_styles.extra: Additional entries layered on top of the base set.
hint.combat_styles.falloff: How quickly the effect weakens with distance.
hint.combat_styles.fx: Visual and sound presentation for this effect.
hint.combat_styles.swing_sound: Sound played when the attack swings.
hint.combat_styles.animation: Animation id played for this attack.
hint.combat_styles.timing: Frame timings controlling when the attack lands.
hint.combat_styles.upswing: Fraction of the swing spent winding up.
hint.combat_styles.movement_speed_multip: Movement speed while the attack plays.
hint.combat_styles.range_multiplier: Multiplies the reach of this attack.
hint.combat_styles.disabled: Turns this entry off without deleting it.
hint.combat_styles.taken_damage_type: Only when the damage taken matches.
hint.combat_styles.become_entity: Entity id that matching summons turn into.
hint.combat_styles.replaced_summoned_ent: Summon ids to replace. Empty means all.
hint.combat_styles.amount: How much the attribute changes by.
hint.combat_styles.operation: add_value adds flat; multiply ops scale the total.
hint.combat_styles.set: Decays to this value over the cooldown.
provides.combat_styles.window.on_shoot: Fires when any projectile you own is launched. Set Uses or Duration to arm instead
provides.combat_styles.window.on_shield_: Fires when you block, with any shield. Set Uses or Duration to arm instead
provides.combat_styles.window.on_use: Fires when the item is used. Without arming, effects are live while using. Needs an item with right-click usage — set one in On Use, or use an item that already has one
dependency.combat_styles.window: Turns an event trigger into an armed window; without one the cooldown just limits how often it fires
provides.combat_styles.window: Fires on this event. Can arm a window instead if Uses or Duration is set
provides.combat_styles.window.on_hurt: Fires when you take damage. Set Uses or Duration to arm instead: a later swing or hit spends it
provides.combat_styles.window.on_kill: Fires on the killing blow. Set Uses or Duration to arm instead: a later swing or hit spends it
provides.combat_styles.window.on_miss: Fires when a swing misses. Set Uses or Duration to arm instead: a later swing or hit spends it
provides.combat_styles.window.on_summon_: Fires when a summon hits. Set Uses or Duration to arm instead: a later swing or hit spends it
dependency.combat_styles.hit: Needs a hit — On Player Hit or On Projectile Hit
provides.combat_styles.hit: Provides a hit: damage dealt and the target
provides.combat_styles.window.on_project: Fires when your projectile hits. Set Uses or Duration to arm instead
Attributes that apply whenever the item is worn.
hint.combat_styles.charge_decay_ticks: Ticks each attack adds back. -1 spends the charge at once.
field.combat_styles.name: Name
hint.combat_styles.projectile: Starts from a projectile in this equipment's Projectiles library. Any field you set here overrides the shared one.
screen.combat_styles.equipment_summon_pr: Use it from any summon profile with Base Profile set to this name. Fields set there override these.
hint.combat_styles.base_profile: Starts from a summon profile in this equipment's Summon Profiles library. Any field you set here overrides it.
screen.combat_styles.equipment_projectil: Use it from any projectile with Shared Projectile set to this name. Fields set there override these.
hint.combat_styles.on_shoot: Fires when any projectile you own is launched — bows, thrown items, your own effects, modded shooters.
hint.combat_styles.on_projectile_hit: Fires when a projectile you fired lands on a living target. Has no combo slot, so slot conditions do not apply.
hint.combat_styles.phase: Which moment fires this. Any means the item completion moment — release for Charge, each tick for Channel, the click for Press. Every fires on all of them (start, each channel tick, release); use it for custom hooks that branch on the phase themselves.
hint.combat_styles.held_above: Requires the item to have been held longer than this, in ticks.
hint.combat_styles.held_below: Requires the item to have been held less than this, in ticks.
hint.combat_styles.on_player_hit: Only during the hit pass — after a melee swing connects.
hint.combat_styles.trigger.on_swing: Only during the swing pass, before anything is struck. No target is available yet.
hint.combat_styles.sprinting: Requires the player to be sprinting. Hit effects check the moment the attack started.
hint.combat_styles.airborne: True requires the player off the ground, false requires them grounded.
hint.combat_styles.behind_target: Requires striking the target from behind. Needs a target.
hint.combat_styles.night: True only at night, false only during the day.
hint.combat_styles.damaged_within: Requires the player to have taken damage within this many ticks.
hint.combat_styles.trigger.damage_type: Damage types that count. Use a #tag for a whole group.
hint.combat_styles.condition.damage_type: Damage types that count. Use a #tag for a whole group.
hint.combat_styles.target: Entity types that count as a valid victim.
hint.combat_styles.distance_above: Requires the projectile to have travelled further than this, in blocks.
hint.combat_styles.distance_below: Requires the projectile to have travelled less than this, in blocks.
hint.combat_styles.on_shield_block: Fires when you block an attack, with any shield.
hint.combat_styles.on_use: Fires when the item is right-clicked. The item needs right-click usage: set one in On Use, or use an item that already has one.
hint.combat_styles.from_summon: Whether a summon firing on your behalf counts as you shooting.
hint.combat_styles.fully_blocked: Only when the shield absorbed the whole hit.
hint.combat_styles.channel_animation: Plays while the item is being used. Loops if the animation file says so.
hint.combat_styles.hold_ticks: How long the item can be held, in ticks. -1 holds until released.
hint.combat_styles.threshold_ticks: Charge only counts once held this long. Releasing earlier does nothing.
hint.combat_styles.channel_start: Wait this long before the channel starts firing effects.
hint.combat_styles.channel_ticks: Fire once every this many ticks while held.
hint.combat_styles.use_pose: The vanilla use pose. Any pose other than none makes Spell Engine show the item in its use slot.
hint.combat_styles.on_hurt: Taking damage arms this effect. It then fires on your next swing or hit, limited by Uses and Duration.
hint.combat_styles.damage_above: Only when the hit dealt more than this.
hint.combat_styles.damage_below: Only when the hit dealt less than this.
hint.combat_styles.on_hurt.damage_above: Only when the hit you took was more than this.
hint.combat_styles.on_hurt.damage_below: Only when the hit you took was less than this.
hint.combat_styles.total_damage_above: Damage summed over 10s must exceed this.
hint.combat_styles.attacker: Only when hurt by these entities.
tooltip.combat_styles.item_slot.head: head slot
hint.combat_styles.dual_wielding: True: two weapons. False: not dual-wielding.
hint.combat_styles.player_tags: You must have all of these /tag tags, or Tags Needed of them. Type each one.
hint.combat_styles.player_tags_min: How many of Player Tags you need. Unset means all of them.
hint.combat_styles.missing_player_tags: You must have none of these /tag tags. Type each one.
hint.combat_styles.two_handed: Main hand weapon. True: two-handed. False: one-handed. Non-weapons fail both.
hint.combat_styles.items: Items to match. Click to open the picker.
hint.combat_styles.self: Checks the item that owns this effect: the weapon for held items, the ring or belt for worn ones. Useful for checking its own enchantments.
field.combat_styles.head: Head
hint.combat_styles.head: Helmet slot check.
hint.combat_styles.excluded_items: Fails if one of these is there. Click to pick.
hint.combat_styles.excluded_tags: Fails if an item in these tags is there.
hint.combat_styles.excluded_categories: Fails if a weapon of these categories is there.
hint.combat_styles.empty: True: slot must be empty. False: something must be there.
hint.combat_styles.enchantments: The item in this slot must carry these enchantments. Add one per enchantment; leave Min/Max out for any level.
hint.combat_styles.enchantments_any: On: one listed enchantment is enough. Off: every listed enchantment must be there.
hint.combat_styles.target_effects: Only counts against targets that have one of these effects.
hint.combat_styles.enabled: Turns this block off without deleting it.
hint.combat_styles.window: Stays usable for a time after it triggers. Uses the effect cooldown.
hint.combat_styles.restart_combo: After the pass ends, the base sequence starts from its first attack instead of resuming where the counter landed.
hint.combat_styles.uses: How many times the effect may fire once armed. 0 is unlimited.
hint.combat_styles.refresh_on_use: Each use restarts the decay timer.
hint.combat_styles.hold_while_active: On: live while the trigger holds; cooldown starts when it ends. Off: the trigger starting opens the Duration window.
screen.combat_styles.default_exported: Exported this sequence as the item's default
screen.combat_styles.default_removed: Removed the exported default; the datapack default is back
screen.combat_styles.content_hint: Click to edit · x delete · ↺ restore datapack version
screen.combat_styles.definition_exists: That id already exists; click it in the list to edit it
screen.combat_styles.custom_style_id.tip: Unique id for this custom style, e.g. quick_cut or mymod:quick_cut.
Groups sort custom styles in the library, e.g. foundation or master.
screen.combat_styles.custom_style_base.t: The attack this style is built on. Its numbers fill anything you don't change.
screen.combat_styles.custom_style_catego: Weapon category it shows under. Inherit uses the base style's category.
screen.combat_styles.custom_style_rarity: Inherit uses the base style's rarity.
screen.combat_styles.custom_style_page.t: Can be found naturally or not.
screen.combat_styles.custom_style_cost.t: Budget cost. Leave empty to work it out from the attack.
screen.combat_styles.custom_style_detail: Change the attack's numbers, add affixes and tuning, and rename it.
screen.combat_styles.custom_style_exists: A custom style with that id already exists
hint.combat_styles.drop_pool.chance: 0 to 1. Odds this pool drops something when a matching loot table rolls. 0 turns it off.
hint.combat_styles.drop_pool.tables: Exact loot table ids this pool drops from. Unknown ids wait until that mod is added.
hint.combat_styles.drop_pool.table_patte: Drops from any loot table whose id contains this text, such as chests/.
hint.combat_styles.drop_pool.entities: Drops when one of these mobs is killed.
hint.combat_styles.drop_pool.entity_tags: Drops when a mob in one of these tags is killed.
hint.combat_styles.drop_pool.structures: Drops from loot rolled inside one of these structures.
hint.combat_styles.drop_pool.structure_t: Drops from loot rolled inside a structure in one of these tags.
hint.combat_styles.drop_pool.entries: What can drop. + opens the item picker: Inventory keeps that exact stack (name, enchantments, its own equipment) as an instance; All items adds a plain item. Items from tags/equipment are always here: removing one only resets its weight.
hint.combat_styles.drop_pool.style_pages: Weight for a random single style page, competing with the entries above. Pages match this pool's rarity (any rarity if none is set). Only styles that can be found naturally. 0 turns it off.
hint.combat_styles.drop_pool.rarity: Rarity used for style pages and style books this pool drops. The six built-in pools use their own rarity when this is empty; custom pools roll a random rarity.
hint.combat_styles.drop_pool.item: Click to pick a different item. Picking a customised stack from your inventory turns this entry into an instance.
hint.combat_styles.drop_pool.stack: One exact item stack with its components. It drops as-is, plus a weapon roll unless Roll is off.
hint.combat_styles.drop_pool.weight: Share of this pool's drops that are this entry. 0 never drops.
hint.combat_styles.drop_pool.table_bonus: Weight added in loot tables whose id contains the key. Negative lowers it.
hint.combat_styles.drop_pool.roll: On: the drop also gets a weapon roll like any found weapon. Off: it drops exactly as authored.
screen.combat_styles.scaled_number_make: ↗ Click the arrow to scale this value with a source, or let it crit.
screen.combat_styles.scaled_number_open: ↗ Click the arrow to edit its scaling and crit. Empty it to make a plain number again.
screen.combat_styles.scaled_number_crit_: Crit group %s: crits together with everything in it
hint.combat_styles.scaled_number.by: Each entry adds its source times Per Point to the base. Sources: Charge, Held Seconds, enchantment levels, attributes and spell power.
hint.combat_styles.scaled_number.scaling: sum adds every entry; strongest keeps only the largest.
hint.combat_styles.scaled_number.min: The result never goes below this.
hint.combat_styles.scaled_number.max: The result never goes above this.
hint.combat_styles.scaled_number.step: Rounds the scaled bonus down to multiples of this, for tiers instead of a smooth curve.
hint.combat_styles.scaled_number.crit: A chance for this value to be multiplied or raised each time it is used. Rolled on the server only; tooltips show the normal value.
hint.combat_styles.crit.group: Pick a group from this equipment's Crit Groups. Every value in the same group crits together on one firing, including projectiles that firing launches.
hint.combat_styles.crit.chance: 0 to 1. Can scale like any value. In a group, the group's chance is used.
hint.combat_styles.crit.mode: multiply: the value is multiplied by Crit Value on a crit. add_value: Crit Value is added instead, so a value of 0 can turn on only when it crits.
hint.combat_styles.crit.value: How much a crit changes the value: the multiplier, or the amount added in add_value mode. Can scale. Set it here to override the group's. The old key multiplier still loads.
hint.combat_styles.crit.on_crit: A payload that fires once when this crits, after the hit's own payloads, on the same target (or around you if there is none).
hint.combat_styles.crit.on_no_crit: A payload that fires once when this rolls and does not crit, after the hit's own payloads. Shares the roll with On Crit, so exactly one of the two fires.
hint.combat_styles.condition.crit: This block only runs when the chosen crit group crits on this hit. If nothing has rolled it yet, this rolls it.
hint.combat_styles.condition.crit_missed: This block only runs when the chosen crit group does not crit on this hit.
hint.combat_styles.thresholds: Only passes while each source is within its bounds: charge, held time, attributes, spell power or enchantment levels.
hint.combat_styles.at_least: Passes when the value is this or higher.
hint.combat_styles.at_most: Passes when the value is this or lower.
screen.combat_styles.equipment_crit_grou: Shared crit rolls. Point a value's crit at @name and every value in that group crits together.
hint.combat_styles.by.mode: per_point: adds source × Per Point. multiplier: multiplies the base. divisor: base × (source ÷ baseline).
screen.combat_styles.summon_field_in_use: Green: already set on this ability
hint.combat_styles.kind: active: the summon casts it on its own timer (put it in a profile's actives). passive: it fires on the summon's hits, hurts or kills (put it in a profile's passives).
hint.combat_styles.actives: Abilities the summon casts on its own timer, and how it picks and aims them.
hint.combat_styles.pick: How the summon chooses which active to cast. in_order: the one at its spawn position. random: any ready one. cycle: steps through them, skipping ones on cooldown.
hint.combat_styles.weapon_roll.weight: How often this roll is picked. Every found weapon gets exactly one roll, drawn by weight among the rolls that match it: weight 10 lands five times as often as weight 2.
hint.combat_styles.weapon_roll.mode: append adds rolled attacks after the weapon's own; replace swaps the whole sequence; slot rewrites only the listed slots; affix keeps the attacks and adds affixes to the listed slots.
hint.combat_styles.weapon_roll.styles: Attacks this roll draws from. Leave empty to draw from the weapon category's own natural attacks.
hint.combat_styles.weapon_roll.slots: Sequence slots slot and affix modes touch. Negative counts from the end (-1 = final). Empty picks one slot at random.
hint.combat_styles.weapon_roll.min_slots: Fewest attacks rolled in append and replace modes.
hint.combat_styles.weapon_roll.max_slots: Most attacks rolled in append and replace modes.
hint.combat_styles.weapon_roll.affixes: Affixes to grant. One is picked at random per attack, up to Max affixes. Leave empty to roll random affixes with Affix chance instead.
hint.combat_styles.weapon_roll.affix_cha: When Affixes is empty: chance per attack to roll a random affix, tried again for each extra affix up to Max affixes.
hint.combat_styles.weapon_roll.max_affix: Most affixes this roll puts on a single attack.
hint.combat_styles.weapon_roll.slot_limi: Overrides how many attacks the weapon's sequence may hold.
hint.combat_styles.weapon_roll.categorie: Weapon categories this roll can land on. Empty matches every category.
hint.combat_styles.weapon_roll.items: Items this roll can land on. Empty matches every item.
hint.combat_styles.weapon_roll.tags: Item tags this roll can land on. Empty matches every item.
hint.combat_styles.weapon_roll.tables: Loot tables this roll is limited to. Currently not applied: rolls match every table.
hint.combat_styles.weapon_roll.names: Renames rolled attacks: attack or animation id to display name.
hint.combat_styles.weapon_roll.name: Name for the rolled sequence. Empty keeps the weapon's own.
hint.combat_styles.spectral: Draws the summon see-through, like a ghost.
hint.combat_styles.keep_gear: A raised mob keeps the gear its victim was holding and wearing.
hint.combat_styles.equipment: Items the summon holds and wears. It never drops them.
hint.combat_styles.mainhand: Item held in the main hand.
hint.combat_styles.offhand: Item held in the off hand.
hint.combat_styles.body: Body armour slot, such as wolf or horse armour.
hint.combat_styles.companion: Keeps summons at your side while this item is held or worn.
hint.combat_styles.respawn_ticks: Ticks before a fallen companion comes back.
hint.combat_styles.follow: Overrides the global summon follow ranges for these companions. Leave a value out to use the config default.
hint.combat_styles.start_distance: Companions walk back to you once they are this many blocks away.
hint.combat_styles.stop_distance: Companions stop following once they are this close to you.
hint.combat_styles.teleport_distance: Companions teleport next to you past this distance, even mid-fight. 0 never teleports.
hint.combat_styles.on_summon_spawn: Fires when one of your summons appears.
hint.combat_styles.on_summon_death: Fires when one of your summons dies.
hint.combat_styles.on_summon_kill: Fires when one of your summons kills something.
hint.combat_styles.summon_entities: Only react to these summon types. Empty means any.
hint.combat_styles.summons_active: Needs at least this many of your summons nearby.
hint.combat_styles.companion.attributes: Stat bonuses the companion spawns with, one entry per attribute.
hint.combat_styles.summons.attributes: Stat bonuses the summon spawns with, one entry per attribute.
hint.combat_styles.own_damage: The summon hits with its own attack instead of damage scaled from you. Eyes and skulls ignore this.
tooltip.combat_styles.equip_hold_while_a: Stays on while active, then recharges for %ss
tooltip.combat_styles.use_charge: Hold to charge, release to use
tooltip.combat_styles.swings.any: Works on swings from either hand
hint.combat_styles.passives: Abilities the summon uses on its own events instead of the recast timer. They run alongside actives and never interrupt them.
hint.combat_styles.on: hit: the summon lands a melee or arrow hit. hurt: the summon takes damage. kill: the summon kills something.
hint.combat_styles.spell_target: Who the summon casts at. auto: the spell's own targeting from the summon, and on you if the spell only helps. hit: its target. self: the summon. owner: you. aim: always the spell's own search.
hint.combat_styles.roll_spell_chance: Passive spells with a trigger chance (like a 20% on-hit) only fire that often. Off: always fire.
hint.combat_styles.trigger_chance_add: Added to a passive spell's trigger chance. 0.1 turns 20% into 30%.
hint.combat_styles.swings: Which swings its swing effects follow while it's in a hand. Own Hand: only swings made by the hand holding it, so slot rules follow that hand's combo. Both Hands: every swing, from either hand. Worn items always use every swing. Click to change. Right-click to hide or show its tooltip line.
hint.combat_styles.active_in: Where the item must be for its effects to work. Worn: armor and accessory slots. Held: main or off hand. Click to change. Right-click to hide or show its tooltip line.
affix.combat_styles.effect.raise_dead: Raises what it kills as your summon
ability.combat_styles.raise_dead.name: Raise the Dead
hint.combat_styles.raise_dead: Raises the mob that was just killed as your summon. Bosses and players are never raised.
hint.combat_styles.entity_tags: Only mobs in these tags. Empty with no Entities: any mob.
hint.combat_styles.exempt_tags: Mobs in these tags are never affected.
hint.combat_styles.lifespan_ticks: How long the raised mob lasts. 20 ticks = 1 second.
hint.combat_styles.options: Settings this ability adds. Only offered for abilities that have their own options.
hint.combat_styles.action.projectile: What this step shoots: the projectile entity, count, speed, spread and its own damage. Uses the step Damage Spec when it has none.
hint.combat_styles.passives.options: Settings for this passive only, on top of the ability's tuning. Prefilled with every option the chosen ability offers.
hint.combat_styles.tuning.damage: How hard this ability hits and what it applies on hit.
hint.combat_styles.tuning.timing: Windup, duration and cooldown of this ability, in ticks.
hint.combat_styles.tuning.shape: Reach, radius, target cap and movement numbers the steps read.
hint.combat_styles.tuning.fx: Particles and sounds the steps play.
hint.combat_styles.ability_tuning.damage: How hard this ability hits and what it applies on hit.
hint.combat_styles.ability_tuning.timing: Windup, duration and cooldown of this ability, in ticks.
hint.combat_styles.ability_tuning.shape: Reach, radius, target cap and movement numbers this ability reads.
hint.combat_styles.ability_tuning.fx: Particles and sounds this ability plays.
hint.combat_styles.action.beam: How the beam looks: colour, width, where it starts and how long it stays. Works on any summon. Leave unset to use the summon's own beam if it has one, otherwise a default red beam.
hint.combat_styles.beam.width: Half-width of the beam in blocks.
hint.combat_styles.beam.lift: Raises the start point by this many blocks. 0.5 is a slab.
hint.combat_styles.beam.origin: Where the beam starts: ability (the summon's ability point), eyes, center or feet.
hint.combat_styles.beam.duration_ticks: How long each beam stays visible. 20 ticks = 1 second.
hint.combat_styles.passives.tuning: Numbers for this passive only: damage, timing, shape, fx and per-step damage. Layered on top of the profile Tuning map.
hint.combat_styles.abilities.tuning: Numbers for this entry only: damage, timing, shape, fx and per-step damage. Layered on top of the profile Tuning map, so the same ability can appear twice with different numbers.
hint.combat_styles.tuning.steps: Damage changes for single steps of a scripted ability. Fields you set overwrite the same fields of that step's Damage Spec; the rest keep the step's values.
hint.combat_styles.ability_tuning.steps: Damage changes for single steps of a scripted ability. Fields you set overwrite the same fields of that step's Damage Spec.
hint.combat_styles.steps.step: Which step to change, counted from 0 in the ability's Steps list.
hint.combat_styles.steps.damage_spec: Damage fields to overwrite on that step. Only the fields you add change.
hint.combat_styles.raise_dead.profile: Which summon profile a raised mob gets its actives and passives from. none: no abilities. matching: only a profile in this Raise the Dead's own Profiles list for that mob type, kept separate from your summons. inherit: that list first, then your equipment profile for that mob type, then your held or worn profile (it can then raise mobs itself if that profile has Raise the Dead).
hint.combat_styles.options.profile: Which summon profile a raised mob gets its actives and passives from. none: no abilities. matching: only a profile in this Raise the Dead's own Profiles list for that mob type, kept separate from your summons. inherit: that list first, then your equipment profile for that mob type, then your held or worn profile (it can then raise mobs itself if that profile has Raise the Dead).
tooltip.combat_styles.raise_dead_profile: Raised mobs use your summon profiles
Raised mobs use a profile made for their type
hint.combat_styles.action.particle_shape: How the step's particles are laid out: cloud, ring, sphere, line (from the summon to the centre), spiral or column. Works on any step that has a Particle.
hint.combat_styles.action.particle: Particle to show. On a particles step it is the action; on any other step it plays alongside it, at the same centre.
hint.combat_styles.particle_shape.form: cloud: random spread. ring: a flat circle. sphere: a ball. line: from the summon to the centre. spiral: a rising helix. column: a vertical line.
hint.combat_styles.particle_shape.radius: Size of the ring, sphere or spiral. 0 uses the ability shape radius.
hint.combat_styles.particle_shape.points: How many particles make up the shape. 0 uses the ability fx particles.
hint.combat_styles.particle_shape.height: Height of a spiral or column in blocks.
hint.combat_styles.particle_shape.turns: How many times a spiral wraps around.
hint.combat_styles.particle_shape.y_offs: Raises the shape above its base. The base is the summon's feet, or the target's feet when At Focus is on.
hint.combat_styles.particle_shape.grow: Scales the size from 0 to full across the ability, so repeating steps draw an expanding shockwave.
hint.combat_styles.raise_dead.profiles: Summon profiles for raised mobs, picked by their Entity. Checked before your equipment's profiles when Profile is matching or inherit.
hint.combat_styles.options.profiles: Summon profiles for raised mobs, picked by their Entity. Checked before your equipment's profiles when Profile is matching or inherit.
screen.combat_styles.effect_row_grant_ab: Gives your summons and/or pets extra actives and passives while this effect is live. Adds on top of any abilities they already have.
hint.combat_styles.ability_grant.applies: summons: only mobs you summoned. pets: only mobs you own that are not summons (tamed wolves, cats, horses...). both: either.
hint.combat_styles.ability_grant.actives: Abilities they cast on their own. Joins any summon profile's pool; its Recast Ticks is used when the summon has none of its own.
hint.combat_styles.ability_grant.passive: Abilities that fire on hit, hurt or kill. Added on top of the summon's own passives.
hint.combat_styles.ability_grant.entitie: Only these mobs get the grant. Empty means any.
hint.combat_styles.ability_grant.entity_: Only mobs in these tags get the grant.
hint.combat_styles.ability_grant.exempt_: These mobs never get the grant.
Mobs in these tags never get the grant.
hint.combat_styles.custom: Code-defined behaviour for this box. Each entry picks a hook a mod registered for this kind of box; the hook's own settings appear under Options.
hint.combat_styles.custom.hook: Which registered hook runs for this box. Only hooks that support this kind of box are listed.
hint.combat_styles.custom.options: Settings the chosen hook exposes. Prefilled with the hook's defaults.
command.combat_styles.skillchoice.none: You have no skill choices yet
command.combat_styles.classkit.rechoose: Reset and reopened the kit choice for %s player(s)
command.combat_styles.classkit.no_starte: Starter Kit is not installed, so the kit choice cannot be reopened
command.combat_styles.skillchoice.unknow: You don't have a skill choice called %s
command.combat_styles.skillchoice.cooldo: You can change %s again in %s seconds
tooltip.combat_styles.grant_removed: Removes the %s affix from your attacks
